result_text:
The stock list of a warehouse now leaves out products with no stock. I changed one SQL condition in `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 1491:

- The `WHERE` clause now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the other stock overviews use.

The per-product quantity lookup is a separate method and still returns 0 for a product with no stock, so the "nuts in WH-1 = 0" case is unchanged.

I ran `StockTest`, `StockOverviewTest`, `StockPerCategoryTest` and `SlowMovingStockTest` offline: 15 tests, all passing. I did not add a test for the warehouse list case from the example. Nothing is committed.
